## Objective
- Improve the graphics of the existing GENESIS living-world game, aiming for an ultra-realistic visual presentation.

## Requirements
- Build on the existing game without asking clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport no wider than 1280px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- No implementation decisions or visual changes have been made yet.

## Work State
### Completed
- Explored the project structure and inspected the existing GENESIS UI, simulation, and CSS graphics.

### Active
- Improve the game’s visual fidelity, especially the ecosystem and cell imagery.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the existing canvas and cell-observatory rendering in `app.js` and related styles.
2. Implement more realistic visuals while preserving the game’s current navigation and interactions.
3. Run the game, capture a small JPEG screenshot, inspect the latest capture, and report the changes and assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: Existing simulation, canvas ecosystem drawing, and UI rendering.
- `style.css`: Existing layout and organism/cell visual styling.
- `index.html`: Game entry point and app structure.

## Important Context
- The existing project is a browser-based biological simulation with a “Living system” overview and “Cell observatory”; it is not a conventional action game.
- Changes are uncommitted; none have been made during this conversation.
